title: alepe — ALEPE open data in R
text: Tidy access open data API Legislative Assembly State Pernambuco, Brazil (ALEPE): representatives, staff, positions, departments, remuneration, contracts, procurement, legislative propositions — tibbles clean names parsed types. Built httr2: local caching, automatic retries exponential backoff, descriptive user agent. Graceful failures: network problems warn return typed zero-row tibbles — pipeline keeps running. Friendly progress messages via cli, silenceable options(alepe.quiet = TRUE).

title: alepe: Access the Open Data API of the Legislative Assembly of Pernambuco — alepe-package
text: tidy interface open data API Legislative Assembly State Pernambuco, Brazil ('ALEPE', https://dadosabertos.alepe.pe.gov.br). Retrieve data representatives, staff, positions, departments, remuneration, contracts, procurement processes, legislative propositions tibbles clean names parsed column types. Requests cached locally retried exponential backoff; network failures handled gracefully.

title: alepe: Access the Open Data API of the Legislative Assembly of Pernambuco — alepe-package
text: alepe.quiet: suppress informational messages. Defaults TRUE non-interactive sessions. alepe.cache_dir: cache location. Defaults tools::R_user_dir("alepe", "cache"). alepe.cache_max_age: cache expiry seconds. Defaults 6 hours. alepe.max_tries: maximum request attempts. Defaults 3, exponential backoff attempts. alepe.timeout: request timeout seconds. Defaults 60; slowest endpoint (/licitacoes) regularly needs close 30 s.

title: Query legislative propositions — alepe_bills
text: Retrieves legislative propositions Assembly: bills (alepe_bills()), indications (alepe_indications()), requests (alepe_requests()). Two query modes supported API:

title: Query legislative propositions — alepe_bills
code: alepe_bills(number = NULL, year = NULL, legislature = NULL, refresh = FALSE)  alepe_indications(   number = NULL,   year = NULL,   legislature = NULL,   refresh = FALSE )  alepe_requests(number = NULL, year = NULL, legislature = NULL, refresh = FALSE)

title: Query legislative propositions — alepe_bills
text: number Proposition number, detail mode. Requires year. year Filter year (listing mode) select proposition (detail mode). legislature Filter legislature number (listing mode). refresh TRUE, bypass local cache.

title: Query legislative propositions — alepe_bills
text: tibble. listing mode, one row per proposition docid, numero, ano, legislatura, tipo, subtipo, ementa, data_publicacao (Date), autores (author names, ;-separated). detail mode, single row numero, ano, legislatura, tipo, autores, ementa, materia, justificativa, regime_tramitacao, impacto_orcamentario, resultado_final, data_publicacao (Date), numero_dpl, lotacao_atual. network failure, zero-column tibble (warning).

title: Query legislative propositions — alepe_bills
text: Detail: pass number year fetch full record single proposition. Listing: pass year /legislature fetch summaries multiple propositions. filter given, API defaults current year. endpoints serve structured data XML embedded CSV; package parses XML fields regular columns, names normalized snake_case HTML markup stripped free-text fields.

title: alepe 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Tidy wrappers documented v1 endpoints ALEPE open data API: representatives, staff, positions, departments, remuneration, contracts, procurements, legislative propositions (bills, indications, requests). Local response cache, exponential-backoff retries, graceful failures compliant CRAN policy internet resources. Every endpoint function Portuguese alias named API endpoint wraps (alepe_servidores(), alepe_contratos(), alepe_projetos(), …); see ?alepe_aliases.
